sources.title: moondream/parakeet-ultra · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Eleven complete TED-LIUM 3 talks of 10-20 minutes each. parakeet-ultra transcribes them through Photon, whose segmenter cuts each talk at pauses found by the model's VAD head into segments of at most 30 seconds; the original runs NeMo's own long-audio path.

sources.title: mldecode/parakeet-ultra-onnx-int8 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Why this model Parakeet Ultra keeps the full-precision parakeet-tdt-.6b-v3 architecture (FastConformer 24×1024, TDT decoder, 25 European languages) and improves it with further training. This repo converts those weights to sherpa-onnx int8 so CPU apps (e.g. DictFlow) get the accuracy without a GPU stack.

sources.title: GitHub - microsoft/VibeVoice: Open-Source Frontier Voice AI
sources.snippet: VibeVoice is a family of open-source frontier voice AI models that includes both Text-to-Speech (TTS) and Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) models. A core innovation of VibeVoice is its use of continuous speech tokenizers (Acoustic and Semantic) operating at an ultra-low frame rate of 7.5 Hz. sources.title: GitHub - jeanthink/parakeet-onnx: NVIDIA Parakeet TDT → ONNX conversion ...
sources.snippet: This repo converts NVIDIA's Parakeet TDT speech recognition models from their native NeMo/PyTorch format into ONNX, so VoiceMate's Windows app can run them locally via ONNX Runtime — no Python, no CUDA, no cloud API needed.
